Safety Guidelines & Trail Etiquette
Help make trails safe and enjoyable for everyone by following these guidelines.
• Keep right, pass on the left, move off the trail when stopping
• Be courteous, yield appropriately, announce your approach
• Be predictable, use hand signals, equip bikes with a white
front light and red taillight for travel before dawn and after dusk
• Be respectful of private property
• Dogs must be on a leash and reined in to within four feet.
Dog handlers must clean up after their dogs and dispose
of dog waste in a sanitary manner
Prohibited Activities
Motorized equipment is prohibited, except official and emergency
vehicles, powered mobility devices for persons with disabilities,
and pedal assisted e-bicycles.
Emergency Numbers
For trail emergencies dial 911
